title: Allergy Action Plan Sign-In Sheet Form
subtitle: An original operational sign-in sheet for allergy action plan that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Allergy Action Plan Sign-In Sheet Form supports the complete allergy action plan workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Allergy Action Plan Sign-In Sheet Form when the assigned allergy-plan coordinator needs one fillable record for approved allergy plan, allergen controls, emergency supplies, response, and handoff without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Allergy action plan sign-in sheet identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this sign-in sheet to one approved allergy plan, allergen controls, emergency supplies, response, and handoff record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

sections.title: Allergy action plan sign-in basis and accountability controls
sections.guidance: Define the operating window, roster source, responsible staff, and release or custody route.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan sign-in, transfer, and release controls
items: Student identity and current allergy plan matched
Arrival or daily plan-readiness check recorded
Emergency medication and supply custody confirmed
Meal, activity, transport, or classroom controls handed off
Response status or no-event status recorded
Guardian or next staff custodian accepted the handoff
Missing plan, supply, control, or symptom held for review
Final supply count and daily documentation reconciled

blocks.label: Identity, release, and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records an allergy action-plan workflow; it does not diagnose an allergy, interpret symptoms, invent exposure limits, or replace qualified directions or emergency services. Use only the current approved plan and authorization. Stop routine activity for any mismatch, suspected exposure, symptom, or unavailable control, protect privacy, and route response decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: Allergy action plan chronological sign-in, transfer, and sign-out entries
sections.guidance: Use one row per participant, volunteer, item custody event, or authorized record handoff.

sections.title: Allergy action plan count reconciliation, exceptions, and authorization
sections.guidance: Preserve the first entry, document corrections, and do not force agreement.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring a status entry
items: Student identity, allergen, plan, or emergency supply does not match
Plan is missing, illegible, expired, changed, or unavailable
Food label, ingredient, meal, snack, or cross-contact control is unclear
Emergency medication, trained staff, or required setting is unavailable
Possible exposure, symptom, reaction, or administration event occurred
Classroom, transport, field trip, or activity environment changed
Immediate breathing, circulation, consciousness, or other emergency concern is active
Response, supply count, notification, or follow-up does not reconcile

blocks.label: Entry, variance, verified fact, temporary control, and owner
Allergy action plan reconciliation decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the guardian, qualified health professional, and authorized allergy-response staff.

sections.title: Allergy action plan held, changed, or disputed handoff
sections.guidance: Hold movement, disclosure, administration, or release when identity or authority is unresolved.

blocks.label: Hold and escalation indicators
items: Routine activity cannot proceed under the current allergy plan
Guardian authorization or qualified plan direction is incomplete
Student, allergen, plan, medication, or supply does not reconcile
Meal, activity, cross-contact, staffing, or setting control is unavailable
Possible exposure, symptom, reaction, or emergency response is active
Response, supply custody, notification, or follow-up remains unresolved

sections.title: Allergy action plan outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan closeout controls
items: Allergy-plan readiness and response status accepted
Guardian and qualified-review communication recorded
Unresolved exposure, control, or supply action has an owner
Emergency medication and equipment returned to approved custody
Meal, facility, health, or program follow-up linked
Allergy record stored with privacy and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.
